title: Rafael and the Verdict
author: Noor Halloran
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
